title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Payment Methods Notice: Card-Processing Grace on Installment Payments
content:
## Payment methods notice: processing grace by card

**Notice.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, the card-processing grace depends on the card that paid the plan's last installment: 10 days for an HSA/FSA card, 5 days for a credit or debit card, and none for any other payment.

The grace is a number of days taken off the calendar days counted since the plan's last installment payment, that is, the posted plan installment payment carrying the highest installment number; the card is the payment method recorded on that payment.

### Grace table

| Payment method of the plan's last installment payment | Grace |
|---|---|
| HSA/FSA card | 10 days |
| Credit card | 5 days |
| Debit card | 5 days |
| Check or any other payment | none |

### Hypothetical cases

- Last installment paid by HSA/FSA card, 45 days ago: 45 days less 10, 35 days.
- Last installment paid by debit card, 45 days ago: 45 days less 5, 40 days.
- Last installment paid by check, 45 days ago: 45 days.
